title: Sandisk Stock (SNDK) Falls 4.1% After Nvidia CEO Exit (Nov 12)
summary: Sandisk (SNDK) closed at $937.46 on Nov 12, down 4.11%, as Nvidia's CEO transition weighed on AI hardware and memory stocks.
body_markdown:
## Why Sandisk Stock Fell


According to[Nvidia's November 12 release, filed with the SEC](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000082/nvidiaannouncesceotransiti.htm) , Jensen Huang stepped down as president, chief executive officer and a member of the board, effective immediately. Chief financial officer Colette Kress became interim CEO while keeping her CFO role, and Harvey C.


Jones was named the board's first chair. Nvidia said it expects operations, customer commitments and its product roadmap to continue without interruption, and that it will still report third-quarter fiscal 2027 results on November 17.


As reported by[Benzinga](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/going-sandisk-stock-thursday-160056781.html) , Sandisk fell as investors cut exposure to AI-linked hardware stocks following[the leadership change at Nvidia](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-stock-falls-after-hours-huang-ouster-report/) and a softer broader market.


The outlet noted that Sandisk supplies enterprise NAND flash memory and solid-state drives that store and deliver large datasets for AI processors, while Nvidia makes the GPUs that run those workloads, which leaves the stock exposed to shifts in AI hardware sentiment and data center spending.


Per[GuruFocus](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/sandisk-stocks-slide-7-83-194401943.html) , the slide erased much of Wednesday's rally, when Sandisk rose alongside Micron after[CoreWeave said its capacity was largely sold out through 2027](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/coreweave-crwv-stock-news-november-12-2026/) , a report GuruFocus credited to 24/7 Wall St.


## SNDK Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- According to[The Motley Fool](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/sandisk-stock-back-above-900-000102062.html) , Sandisk's fiscal first-quarter 2027 adjusted[earnings per share](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/what-is-eps-earnings-per-share-meaning-formula-and-how-to-judge-it/) came in at $49.51, above its $44 to $46 guidance range and up from $1.22 a year earlier.
- The company guided fiscal second-quarter 2027 adjusted earnings per share of $55 to $57 on a pre-split basis, The Motley Fool reported.
- Nvidia said it expects customer commitments and its product roadmap to continue without interruption while its board searches for a permanent CEO.


### Risks


- Nvidia's leadership question is still open: Kress serves as interim CEO until the board names a permanent successor from internal and external candidates, per Nvidia's release.
- The Motley Fool flagged that profits could fall quickly if flash memory prices reverse, and GuruFocus called NAND pricing in Sandisk's next[quarterly report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) the next test.
- The Motley Fool also pointed out that guidance increases are slowing, with the midpoint rising about 43% for fiscal Q1 and about 24% for fiscal Q2.


Next on the calendar, Sandisk's eight-for-one stock split gives holders of record on November 9 seven additional shares per share after the close on November 19, with split-adjusted trading expected to begin November 20, according to GuruFocus, citing the company's 8-K filing.
